units.spine: Where the City Council asks, it is generally given, and the under-clerks of the hall can name every refusal.
The City Council gets the credit for the good years, whether or not it earned them, and the good years are the whole of the argument in its favour.
What is steady here is who answers for the town, and not what the answer is.
Nobody here needs the trouble explained, and it is recent enough that the town refers to it and moves on. The merchant guilds have stopped coming to the sessions.
Crime here holds ground and takes its share of the money, and nobody in the town gives it a closer name than that.
Nothing in the hall has hardened into sides. The factions sit as factions, and no two of them are bound into anything larger.
What the City Council watches for is the town's own temper, since a council falls to unrest and not to a rival.

units.poolKey: governing body name: a SLOT, never a baked noun
units.spine: A traveller who gives the City Council any other title is corrected on the spot.
Everyone who wants the City Council's place is outmatched by it, and not one of them has gone quiet about the wanting.

units.poolKey: legitimacyHold: public backing hardens the hold
units.spine: The City Council is held in place by the people of Rundgate, and what would be a contest in another town is an inconvenience here.
